# Compliance card

At each stage gate (data collection, model training, reporting or deployment), the responsible developer records the status of each parameter together with a justification and evidence.

Source: [Annex B · Compliance Card and JSON Schema](../guideline/14-annex-b-compliance-card-and-json-schema.md) · [Section 10 · Compliance Assessment Process](../guideline/10-compliance-assessment-process.md) · [Section 9 · Responsible AI Metadata Schema](../guideline/09-responsible-ai-metadata-schema.md)
{: .px-source }

!!! note "Nothing leaves your browser"
    The form is not sent or stored anywhere. Download the card and submit it yourself (see [How to submit](#how-to-submit)).

Once it is in the guideline, this page becomes a form with the status, justification and evidence for every parameter, downloadable as JSON (for the metadata pipeline) and as a printable PDF.

## How to submit

Send the downloaded card to the responsible AI reviewer before release, in either of two ways:

- **By email** to rai-reviewer@example.org (placeholder), with the JSON file attached.
- **On GitHub**: open a [Compliance card submission](https://github.com/aldinorizaldy/proteus_rai_guideline/issues/new?template=compliance-card.yml) issue and attach the JSON file. Issues are public: do not attach personal or confidential data.

Source: [Section 10 · Compliance Assessment Process](../guideline/10-compliance-assessment-process.md) · [Section 12 · Governance and Monitoring](../guideline/12-governance-and-monitoring.md)
{: .px-source }
